speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan
text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) whether the Ministry tracks the number of graduates who are unable to find jobs within six months of graduation; and (b) whether job opportunities for new graduates have reduced or improved over the last three years.

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: So, 10% cannot find jobs within six months, but how many is that in absolute terms?

speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
text: The Member might be concerned about the availability of jobs for fresh graduates.
